answer: Latency-Weighted Arrival Ledger: each new identity must publish a signed heartbeat chain whose inter-arrival gaps are checked against a live nebula of independent clock sources. Clones arriving in bursts get their weight capped below the entry threshold at the zenith of the scoring window. Each identity must also maintain a trellis of countersigned receipt paths, so forging N clones costs N times the audit bandwidth and storage of honest single registration, making margin negative.
